title: Fennel and olive chicken bake
summary: Fennel and olive chicken bake is a mediterranean dinner built around skinless chicken thigh fillets and fennel, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Fennel and olive chicken bake into even pieces and toss fennel with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of fennel while you season skinless chicken thigh fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle skinless chicken thigh fillets and pitted black olives among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Fennel and olive chicken bake before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Fennel and olive chicken bake into warm bowls with the juices.
